summary: Vertical Aerospace Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement relating to a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (SEPA) with YA II PN, Ltd., allowing the company to issue up to $500 million in ordinary shares over time. As consideration, Vertical is issuing $2 million in commitment shares (0.40% of the commitment amount), with 50% delivered upon signing on April 20, 2026, and 50% six months later. The share count is based on the prior trading day's closing price; last reported price on April 17, 2026, was $2.99. This is a routine equity line facility, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisors named. The filing is an ordinary capital-raising mechanism under Rule 424(b)(5).
